source_title: On Asymptotically Locally Hyperbolic Metrics with Negative Mass
title: Mass limit of the Maskit gluing of constant-scalar-curvature ALH manifolds at general conformal boundaries

statement_spans.label: author Theorem environment with its own label NoST29VII21.1 (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1823-1835

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the Theorem: for N three-dimensional ALH summands with metrics of the prescribed form and cusp metrics e^{omega_a} h_{kappa_a} punctured at the gluing points, the mass of the Maskit-glued metric converges, as the gluing radius epsilon tends to zero and the gluing parameter i tends to infinity, to the finite limit -sum_a of the Ricci-contraction integrals with conformal factor e^{-omega_a/2} r; the proof adapts the CDW construction to general conformal boundaries, proving existence of the limiting conformal factors omega_a on both summands (the equivalent of Lemma 5.9 of CDW) with the remaining steps as in CDW (source lines 1892-2473)

standard_prerequisites.use: the author's gluing-family passage: the i-indexed family of hyperbolic half-spheres, the isometries Lambda_a producing the glued manifold, and the recall of cusp metrics e^{omega} h on punctured surfaces (GuillarmouSurfaces, ZhangSphere)

core_obligations: Set up the glued manifold and the family of metrics depending on the gluing parameters epsilon and i (proof lines 1892-1915).
Derive the convergence of the conformal factors and the mass contributions on the first summand, controlling the error terms from the change of the conformal factor (proof lines 1916-2193).
Establish the same convergence on the second summand via the embedded Lemma/Corollary chain (proof lines 2194-2469).
Conclude the equivalent of Lemma 5.9 of CDW for both summands and invoke CDW for the rest (proof lines 2470-2472).
proof_roadmap: Glued metric and parameter family (proof lines 1892-1915).
difficulty_reason: H3：1823-1835、1892-2473针对任意非球面conformal boundary的Maskit neck degeneration，构造双端爆破的hyperbolic annulus barrier防面积集中，利用带Dirac源的比较函数把Yamabe方程转为可施Harnack的uniformly bounded-potential方程，得到穿孔面C-infinity局部收敛，再由Deligne-Mumford compactness识别cusp hyperbolic limit并以Gauss-Bonnet保证第二侧面积非零，最终接作者引用的CDW质量公式。难点是退化颈部的非坍缩/无面积损失及limiting conformal factor，不因582行长度判H3。
